# SFM PRO Enterprise Architecture

## Folder Structure

components/
config/
css/
docs/
js/
pages/

## Architecture Principles

- Modular Architecture
- Component Based Design
- Separation of Concerns
- Reusable Components
- Responsive Layout
- Progressive Enhancement

## Protected Folders

config/
database/
js/core/
js/engine/

## Naming Convention

Use consistent names for:

- Files
- Classes
- Functions
- Variables

Never rename protected files without approval.

## Module Lifecycle

Analyze
Design
Develop
Test
Review
Deploy
Maintain
